---
title: stat-bin
subtitle: "Bin statistic: partition x into uniform-width bins, count rows per bin."
category: Stats
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


Either `bins` or `binwidth` fixes the partition; if both are supplied,
`binwidth` wins.

## Usage

```typst
stat-bin(
  bins: 30,
  binwidth: none,
)
```


## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bins` | `30` | Target number of bins when `binwidth` is `none`. |
| `binwidth` | `none` | Fixed bin width. Overrides `bins` when set. |

## Returns

Statistic object with `name: "bin"`, consumed by geom layers.

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/stat-bin-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = range(0, 40).map(i => (x: i * 0.25))
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x"),
  layers: (geom-histogram(bins: 8),),
)
```

[`geom-histogram`](../geoms/geom-histogram.qmd), [`stat-count`](stat-count.qmd).
